_what: Example Danish recall policy. Copy this shape into the DK_POLICY secret; do not commit a real one.
_rule: Excluded term in any read text, or a code set entirely inside excluded divisions => drop. No text at all => keep. Otherwise keep when a code matches a recall_cpv_prefix, or a read text contains a recall_title_terms root.
_surfaces: Four texts are read: the Danish title, the Danish and English titles together, the buyer's own description (udbud.dk carries it in the search row), and the CPV name printed beside the main code.
_boundaries: A term written with spaces around it matches only on a token boundary, because the gate folds every run of punctuation into a space and pads the whole text. So short abbreviations are written spaced, and no term contains a hyphen: `kopi-maskine` in a title folds to `kopi maskine`.
_note: An unrelated illustration (office printing), chosen so that this file discloses nothing about what any deployment looks for.
